shared_elements: standing human figures in ceremonial dress
register or band divisions with ornament
justification: Both depict standing, richly attired human figures with prominent headgear holding attributes, carved in relief, and both use horizontal banding/registers, but that is a generic level of correspondence. A shows long processional files of near-identical figures in strict profile with linear, orderly drapery and beards, while B shows a single large frontal figure in dense, deeply undercut, curvilinear ornament with glyph-like blocks — quite different depictive conventions and compositional schemes.
